description: young woman queen of darkness, an assassin, pale skin, long silver hair, glowing violet eyes, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, the highest and most epic form of all, even richer and more splendid than a god, a tall crown of black thorns with black darkness dripping down from it like smoke, a long cloak of pure black that fades into black mist at the hem, no stars, no sparkles and no dots anywhere, black armour with glowing violet lines, holding two short straight daggers made of pure black shadow, small daggers, not swords and not curved blades, one in each hand, the whole daggers inside the image, elegant and deadly, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same woman: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, even more epic outfit, not this outfit and not these long curved blades
